I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM:

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (dated 5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers checking in at Dock Doors 14–18 at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting their SMS bay assignments. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it was fixed. The note also says to archive the Eau Claire kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window. That date was a year ago, not today.

2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet", which has no date. Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

Things to leave out of the weekly notes:
- Moss's other two North notes mention Quarrendon Freight Lines but have no ticket numbers. Those are the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in.
- Tickets #4409, #4412 and FR-882 come from Moss's Central handoffs note and belong to Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon Freight Lines.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" (spelled with one r) is about a different company that isn't our customer.

I only looked at public files and the channels you're in. Moss hasn't posted in any of those channels, and I couldn't see any Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket files in the share.
